item.title: How a heat pump works

turns.text:
Make a 15-second 16:9 explainer video for my company, Acme Heat Pumps. We sell heat pumps. Explain how one works.

Use a voice-over, and show captions that match it. Use our two colours, #0E7C86 and #F28C28. End on the attached logo, unchanged, for the last 2 seconds. Give me one finished video file.

dialog.agent:
I can generate the explainer footage, but I can’t reliably deliver your **exact finished brief** with the connected tools: the assembly workflow regenerates and animates the logo end card rather than preserving your attached logo unchanged.

I haven’t spent any generation credits.

The proposed voice-over and matching captions are:

> “Heat pumps collect heat from outside air, even when it’s cold. A compressor raises its temperature. That heat moves indoors to warm your home.”

The finished edit would use **#0E7C86** and **#F28C28**, with 13 seconds of explanation followed by your original logo held still for 2 seconds. That exact logo hold needs a standard video editor.

Also, Magic Hour requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or paid usage arrangement for commercial use.
